summary: Backend-only retest of the seat-booking under-report drift fix. Ran the reconcile test file (9/9 PASS) and the full backend pytest suite (68/68 PASS in 12.14s). The previously failing TestDriftHealAndRetry::test_drift_heal_still_rejects_real_conflict is now green, confirming that the pre-attempt _reconcile_event_availability() call in _perform_booking correctly heals under-report drift before the atomic guard runs, preventing the oversell. The reconcile-on-failure + retry path for over-report drift also remains intact (test_drift_is_healed_on_booking_retry PASS). Original F4/F8 seat-map bookability regressions covered by TestSeatMapBookingHappyPath and TestSeatMapTrueConflict — all green. No code changes made; verification only.
seed_data_creation: None - tests self-provision organizer/consumer accounts and events via API
context_for_next_testing_agent: Under-report and over-report drift are both handled: _perform_booking calls _reconcile_event_availability(event_id) BEFORE the first _try_reserve() for seat_map/time_slot, and still reconciles + retries on _try_reserve failure. All 9 tests in test_seat_booking_reconcile.py plus the 59 pre-existing tests are green. No known open issues on booking flow.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: event.booked_seats array could under-report reality when a booking existed in the bookings collection but was missing from the event doc's booked_seats. The atomic $addToSet guard on booked_seats would then succeed on first attempt for a seat that was actually taken, causing oversell. Fix (verified): pre-reconcile event.booked_seats from the source-of-truth bookings collection before the first _try_reserve() so the guard evaluates against accurate state. Post-fix, test_drift_heal_still_rejects_real_conflict simulates an under-reported doc + real conflicting booking and asserts 409 — now passing.
